comment: * Helper for accessing features in {@link android.hardware.display.DisplayManager}.

variables.name: DISPLAY_CATEGORY_ALL
variables.comment:
* An internal category to get all the displays. This was added in SC_V2 and should only be
     * used internally. This is not a stable API so it should not be make public.

variables.name: DISPLAY_TYPE_INTERNAL
variables.comment:
* An internal copy of the type from the platform. This was added in SDK 17 and should only be
     * used internally. This is not a stable API so it should not be made public.

variables.name: DISPLAY_CATEGORY_PRESENTATION
variables.comment:
* Display category: Presentation displays. *

* This category can be used to identify secondary displays that are suitable for * use as presentation displays. *

* * @see android.app.Presentation for information about presenting content * on secondary displays. * @see #getDisplays(String)

variables.name: DISPLAY_CATEGORY_BUILT_IN_DISPLAYS
variables.comment:
* Display category: Built in displays. *

* This category can be used to identify displays that are built in to the device. *

* @see #getDisplays(String)

methods.name: public static DisplayManagerCompat getInstance(@NonNull Context context)
methods.comment: * Gets an instance of the display manager given the context.

methods.name: public Display getDisplay(int displayId)
methods.comment:
* Gets information about a logical display.
     *
     * The display metrics may be adjusted to provide compatibility
     * for legacy applications.
     *
     * @param displayId The logical display id.
     * @return The display object, or null if there is no valid display with the given id.

methods.name: public Display @NonNull [] getDisplays()
methods.comment:
* Gets all currently valid logical displays.
     *
     * @return An array containing all displays.

methods.name: public Display @NonNull [] getDisplays(@Nullable String category)
methods.comment:
* Gets all currently valid logical displays of the specified category. *

* When there are multiple displays in a category the returned displays are sorted * of preference. For example, if the requested category is * {@link #DISPLAY_CATEGORY_PRESENTATION} and there are multiple presentation displays * then the displays are sorted so that the first display in the returned array * is the most preferred presentation display. The application may simply * use the first display or allow the user to choose. *

* * @param category The requested display category or null to return all displays. * @return An array containing all displays sorted by order of preference. * * @see #DISPLAY_CATEGORY_PRESENTATION

methods.name: private static Display[] computeBuiltInDisplays(DisplayManager displayManager)
methods.comment:
* Returns an array of built in displays, a built in display is one that is physically part
     * of the device.

methods.name: private static int numberOfDisplaysByType(int type, Display[] displays)
methods.comment: * Returns the number of displays that have the matching type.

methods.name: static int getTypeCompat(@NonNull Display display)
methods.comment:
* An internal method to get the type of the display using reflection. This is used to support
     * backporting of getting a display of a specific type. The preferred way to expose displays is
     * to have a category and have developers get them using the category.
